name: hugmesh-games-arch-e2e
description: Self-contained multi-user architecture e2e harness for the 14 web-native games. No external deps — Node 20+ global fetch + a manual SSE line-reader. Proves the host-authoritative SSE relay, sessions, multiplayer delivery, and cross-session isolation REALLY work in the deployed sdgames stack, plus manifest/visibility/bundle-serve facts.
